## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The finding "Stop refresh from overwriting tracked fingerprints" must be fixed before merge: `refresh_fingerprints` re-hashes a hand-edited tracked file, so verification passes on the edit the pull-request description says existing fingerprints detect.

## Changes
The pull request adds `refresh_fingerprints` and `register_new_files` to `app/integrity.py`, both of which rewrite the JSON fingerprint manifest, plus an unused `REVIEW_NOTE` constant. It also adds `tests/test_integrity.py` with one test per helper.

## Critical
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Stop refresh from overwriting tracked fingerprints — A hand-edited `tracked.txt` passed to `refresh_fingerprints` gets its stored digest replaced by the edited file's digest, so `verify` returns True. Line 17 assigns unconditionally, unlike the `name not in entries` guard at `app/integrity.py:24`; the added refresh test passes only an unedited tracked file. — Running refresh after adding files erases the evidence of hand edits to tracked files, defeating the detection the pull-request description promises. — Fix: Either skip names already in the manifest as `app/integrity.py:24` does, or raise when a tracked file's digest differs, and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries` with an edited tracked file.
